text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hello there! Here, please have this flyer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon whisks a glossy flyer into
my hands.
It reads, "A Festival☆of a
Hundred Idols!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be there as a representative for
Umadols! If
you have the time... No, I
mean, you'd better
come cheer me on,
or else!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to practice nonstop for the
event so I
can show everyone just how
amazing Umadols
are!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her extraordinary cheer and energy
leaves a
lingering impression on me as I
make my way to
the track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Falcon said that "front runners've gotta
leave! ☆"
...Have we left sufficiently?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think it should be fine to keep going. I
still want
to run anyway.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: W-wait! That's not what I said!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I said that us front runners've gotta lead! Which'd admittedly be easier on dirt! I wanna win center stage toooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, is this even the kind of practice
I should be
doing right now? Shouldn't I
be focusing on more
Umadol-y things?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh! Great timing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering if I could I get your
input on
something. What do you think
is the best thing
about Umadols?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is it how cute they are? Or maybe how
powerful
their performances are?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's okay! Just look at me and tell me
what your
knee-jerk answer is!
choice_data_list: そもそもウマドルって――

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Okay, time to train my
cuteness!
choice_data_list: ウマドルと言えばかわいい！
ウマドルと言えばパワー！

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now just follow my lead. Reaaaady?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Teehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oopsies! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How was that? Do you think I'm good
enough to
outshine a hundred idols?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I sure do! ♪ But if you're still feeling
anxious, I
could give you a full crash
course on being cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you in on a trick to not just
capture
people's hearts, but their minds,
their futures...
everything. Everyone'll
spend so much time
thinking about you,
they'll forget everything
else! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Gulp... Everyone's... everything...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, this doesn't feel right at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the practice session
through, I go out
and don't get back till
late. When I return...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup, power is definitely a huge part of
an
Umadol's appeal!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And I know just the person to ask for
help when it
comes to building strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Great work! Your muscles are leaping for
joy! Ten
more deadlift reps to go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nrghhh... hrghhh! ☆ Yaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Man, you're really something! You've
got a great
set of muscles! Keep going
and they'll bulk up in
no time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aw, Ryan! Hey, then do you think—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You can reach the top, I just know it!
You're sure
to nab first place in any
bodybuilding contest you
enter!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No thank you! No bodybuilding contests
for me!
I'll be sure to show off my new
muscles at my next
concert, though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the practice session
through, I go out
and don't get back till
late. When I return...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Umadols... for life...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Wow, we've been running into each
other a
lot. Thanks for tagging along
with my training
session earlier today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep! There's going to be a hundred idols

performing together, after all. This is my
big
chance to show fans what being an
Umadol is all
about!
choice_data_list: 君……まだ頑張ってたのか？
貴方……まだ頑張ってたの？

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm super-duper cute and powerful to
boot! Even
if I've... still got a long way to
go.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But despite that, they still picked me to represent Umadols! I've got to put on the best performance I can for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umadols were the ones who showed me
a dream,
and I want to do the same and
give hope to
others too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: 君はウマドルが大好きなんだな
貴方はウマドルが大好きなんだね

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! I... I really love
Umadols.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Maybe that was the most important
thing all
along... Hehe, thanks for the
hint!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I should give you a guest pass for all
your
troubles. ☆ Now you have to come!
